entries.name: Data dictionary
entries.definition:
STG and MART objects are tables. CORE and PROD objects are views.
Enrollment key in CORE/MART member models: `member_cin` + `ecm_enrollment_start_date`. Member-month grain is `member_cin` + `reporting_month`. Keep `member_cin` as text end-to-end — CINs that contain the letter `E` (e.g. `9XXXXXXXE2`) become Excel floats like `9.63E+09` if opened as numbers, which creates a duplicate No-service member-month row beside the real CIN. The pipeline runbook has the repair steps.

entries.name: Staging (VayuHealth_Program_STG)
entries.definition:
Source-level tables for one `reporting_month`. Reruns delete and reload that month. Enrolled and discontinued workbooks both contribute all six subject tabs into **shared** `STG_Member_*` tables; `source_population` distinguishes origin. Rows are restricted to provider **Vayu Health** (New Life Discovery Project, Inc. and other providers are not loaded). Recurring STG names do not use “Cumulative”. Prior `STG_Cumulative_Members_*` and `STG_Enrolled_Members_*` / `STG_Discontinued_Members_*` are retired from monthly writes. MIG Tableau landing is one-time only (through 2026-08-31). PRAPARE uses a separate full-history MERGE into `STG_PRAPARE_Assessments`; it does not replace a reporting-month slice.
Shared lineage on every staging table: `source_file_name`, `source_file_path`, `source_uri`, `source_population` (`enrolled` / `discontinued` / `historical_cumulative` / `activity_log` / `ecmplus` / `ecm_tracker` / `prapare`), `source_sheet`, `reporting_month`, `reporting_month_date`, `load_timestamp`, `loaded_at`, `pipeline_run_id`.

entries.name: STG_Member_Appointments
entries.definition:
Loaded from the **Appointments** sheet on Enrolled and/or Discontinued Pop Builder workbooks. Same month-slice replace as the other STG tables. Feeds `CORE_Member_Appointments`. This is the recurring appointments source. `MIG_Tableau_Appointments` is a one-time historical lander and is not the monthly upstream.
Sprite columns are kept under snake_case names (`specialist_name`, `service_name`, `vendor_name`, `start_time`, `id`, and the rest of the sheet). `start_time` is stored as text so an invalid clock value does not fail the load and so the time is not truncated to a date. `appointment_date` stays a date when the sheet has a separate date column.
Appointments keep a row when `vendor_name` and `provider` are Vayu Health or blank. Any other populated vendor or provider (including New Life Discovery Project, Inc.) is dropped at load. SQL repeats that allow-list.

entries.name: STG_ECMPlus_Encounters
entries.definition: ECM+ encounters CSV only. Required: `member_cin`, `encounter_date`. Optional but preferred: `encounter_id` (unique per encounter). Monthly extracts may include other `encounter_date` months; the loader replaces only the current `reporting_month` slice, then **skips rows whose `encounter_id` already exists elsewhere in STG** (composite identity fallback if `encounter_id` is blank). Precomputed BH/RD / `is_duplicate_row` columns from the extract are dropped so SQL owns BH/RD. Sprite claim-line columns (`claim_amount`, `claim_status`, `claim_service_code`) are dropped on load — those fan one encounter into many CSV rows; claim itemization stays in a separate script. The loader then **collapses to one STG row per `encounter_id`** so CORE / MART / PROD stay at encounter grain. Optional Sprite demo fields (gender, city, zip, etc.) are kept when present for PROD demo coalesce.

entries.name: STG_Staff_Performance
entries.definition:
Sprite Staff Performance CSV (`{YYYY.MM}_Staff Performance.csv`). Loaded into a **dedicated** table. Does **not** write `STG_Member_Activity_Log`. Required: `member_cin`, `activity_date` (from `activityDate`). Maps `activityId` → `id`, `activityType` → `touch_type`, `outreachChannel` → `outreach_channel`. Keeps Vayu Health provider rows when `activityPerformedByProvider` is present.
The export may be **full history** (first setup) or **one month** (ongoing). Each load:
Dedupes the file on Sprite `activityId` (`id`)
Deletes existing STG rows whose **`activity_date` month** appears in the file
Appends the file
Runs a BigQuery uniqueness pass (one row per `id`)
So the August bootstrap file replaces Jul 2023–Aug 2026 activity months in one shot; a later September-only file replaces only September and keeps prior history. `reporting_month` on the row is lineage for the Drive folder month; Tableau months use `activity_date` in CORE/PROD. `source_population = staff_performance`. Feeds `CORE_Member_Initial_Outreach_Activities` → `VW_Initial_Outreach_Events`.

entries.name: CORE_Phase1_Member_Outcomes
entries.definition:
Additive lifecycle view. Grain is one row per enrollment episode (`member_cin` + enrollment start) plus one `OUTREACH` row per never-enrolled member. Reuses first-outreach activity from `CORE_Member_Initial_Outreach_Activities`, enrolled episodes from `MART_Cumulative_Members`, and outreach / recent enrollment fallback from `CORE_ECM_Tracker_Members`. The view resolves historical cumulative MART column names such as `membercin` as well as canonical names such as `member_cin`; it does not rename or alter the MART table.
Key fields:
For a first enrollment episode, qualifying outreach is on or before the ECM start. For a re-enrollment episode, qualifying outreach must be after the previous episode end and on or before the new ECM start. Counts and first outreach dates are therefore episode-specific and are not copied across a member's enrollment episodes.
`region` on this view, and on the other outreach views, is grouped: Humboldt and Sierra (any capitalization) become `Humboldt`; Shasta, Tehama, and Trinity are each folded to one title-case label. Other region text is left as exported. The grouping is applied after cumulative, Tracker, and outreach region are coalesced, so a mixed-case value from the book or Tracker still lands in the grouped label.
The CORE view retains `discontinuation_reason_code` and `discontinuation_reason_source_text` for lineage. The PROD view publishes only `discontinuation_reason`. A numeric source code is mapped first, so code `1` always becomes `The Member has met all care plan goals` even if the free-text reason field says something else. An unknown numeric code is published as `Unmapped discontinuation reason` for visible QA rather than as a number.

entries.name: CORE_Member_Appointments
entries.definition:
One row per appointment from `STG_Member_Appointments`. Dedupe key is the Sprite appointment id when it is present, otherwise member + start + service + specialist + status.
`start_date_time` is a DATETIME. STRING sources are parsed with safe formats (`MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm` and ISO). Invalid text becomes NULL. DATE or DATETIME or TIMESTAMP sources are cast to DATETIME. If the clock is missing, `appointment_date` fills midnight. `appointment_date` is `DATE(start_date_time)`. `appointment_reporting_month` is `DATE_TRUNC(appointment_date, MONTH)`. The file-load month stays on `source_reporting_month`.
`is_completed_appointment` is true when the trimmed status, ignoring case and repeated spaces, is `completed`. Display status for that case is `Completed`. Other statuses stay as exported. `checkedIn`, `provider no-show`, `cancelled`, and `scheduled` are not completed.
`is_valid_vendor` is true only when both `vendor_name` and `provider` are blank or `Vayu Health` (case and extra spaces ignored).
Visit flags are 0/1 on `service_name`. See `docs/metric_definitions.md`. Rows that fail vendor, CHW, or completed rules stay in this view.
Internal Sprite fields (organization id, member id, trigger, reschedule flag, created date, reason, specialization, requester role, rating, last modified) stay here and are not on the PROD view.

entries.name: VW_Completed_Appointments
entries.definition: Tableau source. One row per CHW appointment with a Vayu Health or blank vendor, every status. Filter `is_completed_appointment` for completed-visit charts. `reporting_month` is the appointment month (DATE, first of month), not a single hard-coded month. Visit columns: `phase_1_visits`, `chw_in_person_visits`, `chw_remote_visits`, `pcp_visits`. `appointment_status` is the exported status, with completed normalized to `Completed`. `region` is grouped like the other Tableau views: Humboldt and Sierra (any capitalization) publish as `Humboldt`; Shasta, Tehama, and Trinity are each one title-case label so `HUMBOLDT` and `Humboldt` do not split filters. Appointment sheets do not carry region; demos come from cumulative book → ECM+ → Tracker. When that coalesced region is blank but `county` is present (common on Tracker outreach rows), `region` is imputed from county (strip a trailing ` County`) and `region_imputed_from_county` is true. Prefer fixing Tracker/Sprite region upstream when possible.

entries.name: CORE_Member_Pathway
entries.definition: One row per `(member_cin, ecm_enrollment_start_date)`: `member_name` and `workflow_status` from `MART_Cumulative_Members` (legacy `membername` / `workflowstatus` when the normalized column is blank; current enrollment fills a still-blank value), device flags, 60-day measurement flags, `cgm_type`, `bgm_type`, and a single `pathway` label. The first matching rule wins: (1) Active CGM + recent GMI = `CGM Active`; (2) Active CGM + no recent GMI = `Possible CGM Malfunction`; (3) No active CGM + recent GMI = `Possible CGM Malfunction`; (4) Active BGM + recent glucose = `BGM Active`; (5) Active BGM + no recent glucose = `Possible BGM Malfunction`; (6) No active BGM + recent glucose = `Possible BGM Malfunction`; (7) everything else enrolled = `A1c`; (8) not enrolled = blank on this CORE view. Monthly MERGE into `MART_Cumulative_Members` keeps the last non-blank `pathway` when Incoming is blank (discharge stick). No active device includes an inactive device and no device of that type. A recent measurement with no matching active device is a malfunction.

entries.name: Mart / Prod (VayuHealth_Program_MART, VayuHealth_Program_PROD)
entries.definition:
`MART_Cumulative_Members` is the persistent member book (“Cumulative” lives here). Historical seed through 2026-08-31 is complete (`MIG_Tableau_Cumulative_Members` / cleaned base). Do not reseed or delete historical rows. Monthly applies MERGE this month's Incoming into that table: update matching keys, insert new enrollments, never delete rows that are only in the base. The book stores pipeline snake_case names. `VW_Cumulative_Members` publishes the seeded cumulative-file headers (`workflowStatus`, `Pathway`, `Phase_1_Days`, `HbA1c_GMI_Baseline`, and the rest of that file) so Tableau can keep those fields. **Tableau must use this view, never `MART_Cumulative_Members`.** A bare `SELECT *` from MART exposes snake_case names (`workflow_status`) and invalidates the workbook; the SQL apply asserts the published names after every run. BigQuery treats column names as case-insensitive, so snake_case aliases such as `pathway` are not published next to `Pathway`. Columns that are not on the file, including clinical markers and device flags used by the phase and pathway calculations, are still on the view under their stored names. `region` on that view is grouped: Humboldt and Sierra become Humboldt; Shasta, Tehama, and Trinity are each one title-case label.
On MATCH, baselines, Phase 1–4 dates/days, and `care_coordinator_team` are **fill-blank only**. For **Enrolled** rows with a start date, Incoming may NULL `discontinuation_date` / `ecm_enrollment_end_date` when that date is strictly before the start (stale other-program exit); MERGE accepts the clear. Non-enrolled rows keep fill-blank on those exit dates. `discontinuation_reason` and `discontinuation_reason_code` come from the MIF tab and replace the stored value only when MIF has a value (also cleared when the Enrolled stale-disc rule nulls the date). Six-month / most-recent A1c and assessment most-recent overwrite only when Incoming has a value. Pathway, workflow status, and other non-locked fields still refresh from CORE. `pof` is the Demographics column. `dm_type` / `direct_referral` are computed on Incoming from tags. A confirmed enrollment requires a start date and care team Sequoia, Redwoods, Mariposa, or Sundial. Rows already on MART that fail that test are not deleted; they drop out of the monthly update until the stored team is an official team.
`MART_Monthly_Members_Serviced` is one row per `member_cin` + `reporting_month`. **Purpose:** the program member-month book — every member whose enrollment episode overlapped the reporting month (still enrolled or discontinued during the month), whether or not they had documented ECM/ECM+ service that month. Spine = ECM/ECM+ event members for the month **union** members with an overlapping enrollment episode on `MART_Cumulative_Members` (`active_during_month = 1`). Service fields come from `MART_Monthly_ECM_ECMPlus_Events`; `ecm_category = No service` means no ECM and no ECM+ that month (missed opportunity on the roster), including members discontinued in-month. **Coalesce order (first non-null wins per field):** (1) `MART_Cumulative_Members` with flexible name matching — episode preference exact `ecm_enrollment_start_date` → overlapping episode in the reporting month → latest cumulative row for that CIN; (2) `CORE_ECMPlus_Member_Demos`; (3) `CORE_ECM_Tracker_Members`. `pathway` comes only from that cumulative episode (ECM+ and Tracker pathway values are not used). `pof` and `discontinuation_reason_code` come from the cumulative book only. Blank pathway is not enrolled, including Exclude. Key service fields: `ecm_category` (`ECM only` / `ECM+ only` / `ECM and ECM+` / `No service`), `ecm_valid_activity_count`, `ecm_billed_touch_count`, `bh_count`, `rd_count`, `bh_or_rd_count`, `both_bh_and_rd_flag`, `no_service_in_the_month`. Active membership flags: `active_during_month`, `active_at_month_end`, `new_enrollment_in_month`, `discontinued_in_month` (`discontinued_in_month` = end date and/or discontinuation date falls in the reporting month; see `docs/metric_definitions.md`).

`MART_Monthly_Members_Serviced` is one row per `member_cin` + `reporting_month`. **Purpose:** the program member-month book — every member whose enrollment episode overlapped the reporting month (still enrolled or discontinued during the month), whether or not they had documented ECM/ECM+ service that month. Spine = ECM/ECM+ event members for the month **union** members with an overlapping enrollment episode on `MART_Cumulative_Members` (`active_during_month = 1`). Service fields come from `MART_Monthly_ECM_ECMPlus_Events`; `ecm_category = No service` means no ECM and no ECM+ that month (missed opportunity on the roster), including members discontinued in-month. **Coalesce order (first non-null wins per field):** (1) `MART_Cumulative_Members` with flexible name matching — episode preference exact `ecm_enrollment_start_date` → overlapping episode in the reporting month → latest cumulative row for that CIN; (2) `CORE_ECMPlus_Member_Demos`; (3) `CORE_ECM_Tracker_Members`. `pathway` comes only from that cumulative episode (ECM+ and Tracker pathway values are not used). `pof` and `discontinuation_reason_code` come from the cumulative book only. Blank pathway is not enrolled, including Exclude. Key service fields: `ecm_category` (`ECM only` / `ECM+ only` / `ECM and ECM+` / `No service`), `ecm_valid_activity_count`, `ecm_billed_touch_count`, `bh_count`, `rd_count`, `bh_or_rd_count`, `both_bh_and_rd_flag`, `no_service_in_the_month`. Active membership flags: `active_during_month`, `active_at_month_end`, `new_enrollment_in_month`, `discontinued_in_month` (`discontinued_in_month` = end date and/or discontinuation date falls in the reporting month; see `docs/metric_definitions.md`).

entries.name: Flourish PAM
entries.definition:
`Flourish_Member_Crosswalk` is one active verified mapping per Flourish identifier. It is not rebuilt by the monthly Sprite truncate/replace loads. `Flourish_PAM_Assessments` is the current full-history Flourish snapshot. Names, date of birth, postal code, and Q1–Q13 stay on that table.
`CORE_Flourish_PAM_Assessments` is one source row. Unmatched assessments keep a null CIN. `VW_PAM_Assessments` adds at most one `MART_Cumulative_Members` episode open on the completion date. `reporting_month` is the UTC completion month.
`VW_PAM_Member_Month` is one CIN, survey series, and completion month. `VW_PAM_Member_Summary` is one CIN and survey series. `VW_PAM_Member_CIN_Filter` is one row per CIN only when one series is configured. Definitions: [`flourish_pam.md`](flourish_pam.md).
Demographics on the PAM PROD views come from `MART_Cumulative_Members` whenever the mapped CIN appears on the cumulative book (verified crosswalk identity; Flourish name is not re-matched). Prefer the episode open on the Flourish completion date; otherwise the current/latest episode for that CIN. `health_plan` is the same as `organization`. `partner` and `dm_type` are separate cumulative-book fields (same meanings as on `VW_Member_Month`). Demographics stay null only for unmatched Flourish IDs, CINs absent from the cumulative book, or blank source fields on the picked episode.
`VW_PAM_Enrollment_Outcomes` and `VW_PAM_MoM_Run_Chart` are Flourish A1c-style enrollment/MoM products (all surveys pooled). `distribution_pam_level` / `distribution_pam_score` carry baseline when there is no post-180-day Flourish assessment. They are not the Trend paired views.

entries.name: Pathway
entries.definition:
Window: **60 days** through as-of date, inclusive. Pathway is populated only when `workflow_status` is `enrolled`.
A device is CGM if `device_type` is `CGM` (or continuous-glucose) or `device_name` is one of the known Dexcom / Libre / Guardian kits.
A device is BGM if type or name is `Self-monitoring blood glucose system (SMBGS)` / SMBGS.
**Active** means Device tab `status` = `Active` (case-insensitive). No active device means there is no Active row of that type. That includes an inactive device and no device of that type.
`cgm_type` = CGM device **name**. `bgm_type` = BGM device **type** (Device tab `type` column).
Final pathway priority. The first matching rule wins.
A member is CGM Active only when they have an active CGM device and a recent 1-month GMI value. A member is BGM Active only when they have an active SMBGS/BGM device and a recent glucose marker. A member is a possible malfunction when the device and measurement data do not agree: either the active device exists but the expected recent measurement is missing, or the recent measurement exists but the matching active device is missing. Everyone else who is enrolled falls back to A1c. CORE leaves not-enrolled (including Exclude) blank.
**Persistence on discharge:** monthly MERGE into `MART_Cumulative_Members` overwrites `pathway` only when Incoming has a non-blank value. When a member is discontinued, the last known Pathway mapping sticks on the book (it is not written blank). MoM history uses that stuck value (or prior-month carryforward) for the discharge month.
Glucose markers: `Glucose`, `Mean Plasma Glucose`, `Blood Sugar Fasting Marker`, `Blood Sugar Before Meal`.
`Pathway` on `MART_Cumulative_Members` / `VW_Member_Month` is refreshed each monthly run for enrolled episodes and retained on discharge. It is not a month-over-month history by itself — use `VW_Member_Pathway_Month` for MoM counts.

entries.definition:
Grain: `(member_cin, reporting_month)` and `ecm_enrollment_start_date` when present.
**Historical wide sheet** (Google Sheet export): one row per member; month columns like `26-Feb` / `Jan 26` / `YYYY-MM` with cell values blank / `A1C` / `BGM` / `CGM`. The loader unpivots to long grain and **loads only non-blank pathway months** (pre-enrollment blanks, e.g. Jan–Jul for an August enrollee, stay in the sheet but are not written to MART). Identity columns: CIN, Member Name, Start Date, Care Team, LCM, CDCES.
**Ongoing monthly (forward-looking only):** when you apply cumulative members for a `reporting_month`, that apply also snapshots episodes that overlap the month — still enrolled **or** discharged in-month — from `MART_Cumulative_Members` into the pathway STG/MART/VW. Discharges keep their latest Pathway (MERGE does not blank it; snapshot also carries forward the prior pathway month if the book value is already blank). Re-running the same month replaces that pathway month slice. Do not reconstruct older months or re-export the Google Sheet for new months unless correcting history.
`pathway_group` is the MoM chart bucket: `A1c` / `BGM` / `CGM` / `Other`. Sheet `A1C`/`BGM`/`CGM` map to those groups. Cumulative labels such as `CGM Active` or `Possible CGM Malfunction` map to group `CGM` (detail stays on `pathway`).
Tableau: `reporting_month_date` on Columns, `pathway_group` on Color, `COUNTD(member_cin)` on Rows. Filter out blank/`Other` when the chart should show only confirmed A1c/BGM/CGM. Demographics on the view (region, organization/`health_plan`, care team, POF, etc.) come from the cumulative book join, so filters on this view match other member graphs.

`ecm_enrollment_start_date` is not null
`care_coordinator_team` is `Sequoia Team`, `Redwoods Team`, `Mariposa Team`, or `Sundial Team` (spacing and case ignored)

entries.name: Stale discontinuation / end date before current enrollment (Enrolled)
entries.category: Stale discontinuation / end date before current enrollment (Enrolled)
entries.topic: Stale discontinuation / end date before current enrollment (Enrolled)
entries.definition:
Sprite Demographics sometimes carries another program's prior exit onto a member who is **Enrolled** in our program with a later `ecm_enrollment_start_date`.
Rule (pandas workbook and BigQuery CORE → Incoming → MART MERGE):
Member is on the **Enrolled Members** file (`source_population = enrolled` / enrolled roster)
`workflow_status` = `Enrolled`
`ecm_enrollment_start_date` is populated
`discontinuation_date` **or** `ecm_enrollment_end_date` is populated and is **strictly before** that start date
→ Null that stale date. When `discontinuation_date` is cleared, also clear `discontinuation_reason` / `discontinuation_reason_code`.
Example: Enrolled in October 2026 with start in 2026, but Demographics still shows a April 2026 discontinuation from another program → null the April date.
For Enrolled rows, monthly MERGE **accepts Incoming NULL** on `discontinuation_date` / `ecm_enrollment_end_date` so a cleaned Incoming value can clear a locked historical MART date. Non-enrolled rows keep fill-blank behavior for those exit dates.

entries.name: HbA1c / GMI baseline
entries.definition:
Among valued HbA1c or 1-month GMI **strictly before** ECM enrollment start, pick the **closest** to enrollment (smallest absolute day gap). Do not compare measurement values.
If none before enrollment, among valued HbA1c / GMI **on or after** enrollment, pick the closest to enrollment.
Same-distance ties prefer HbA1c over GMI.
Once a baseline (value, date, marker) is filled on the MART / master row, monthly runs **do not overwrite** it (fill blank only). Same lock applies to PHQ-9 / DDS / GAD-7 / PAM Level / PAM Score baselines.

entries.name: HbA1c / GMI 6-month and most-recent (legacy, labeled)
entries.definition:
Kept for migration parity on the lower-of-markers pick. Both are limited to the enrollment episode window.
**6-month:** earliest HbA1c after day 180 and earliest GMI after day 180 (and on/before episode end), then the **lower** value.
**Most recent:** latest HbA1c and latest GMI with measurement date in `[enrollment_start, episode_end]`, then the **lower** value.
On MERGE into `MART_Cumulative_Members`, 6-month and most-recent metabolic fields (and assessment most-recent fields) **overwrite only when Incoming has a non-blank value**. Blank Incoming does not clear a prior MART score.

entries.name: Member-month purpose and spine
entries.definition:
`MART_Monthly_Members_Serviced` / `VW_Member_Month` is the **program member-month book**, not a serviced-only extract.
**Grain:** one row per `member_cin` + `reporting_month`.
**Who is included:** every member whose enrollment episode overlapped the reporting month on `MART_Cumulative_Members` (still enrolled **or** discontinued during the month), **plus** any member with in-window ECM/ECM+ events that month.
**With or without service:** `ecm_category = No service` means the member had **no** ECM and **no** ECM+ service record in that reporting month — a missed opportunity on the roster. That includes members who were still enrolled and members discontinued in the month. Zero touch counts on those rows are intentional.
**Tableau:** use `active_during_month` / `active_at_month_end` for headcount trends; use `ecm_category` / touch flags for service charts (and filter Team Conference on the events view when needed). `discontinued_in_month` flags anyone whose `ecm_enrollment_end_date` **and/or** `discontinuation_date` falls in the reporting month.

**Who is included:** every member whose enrollment episode overlapped the reporting month on `MART_Cumulative_Members` (still enrolled **or** discontinued during the month), **plus** any member with in-window ECM/ECM+ events that month.
**With or without service:** `ecm_category = No service` means the member had **no** ECM and **no** ECM+ service record in that reporting month — a missed opportunity on the roster. That includes members who were still enrolled and members discontinued in the month. Zero touch counts on those rows are intentional.
**Tableau:** use `active_during_month` / `active_at_month_end` for headcount trends; use `ecm_category` / touch flags for service charts (and filter Team Conference on the events view when needed). `discontinued_in_month` flags anyone whose `ecm_enrollment_end_date` **and/or** `discontinuation_date` falls in the reporting month.

entries.name: Member-month KPIs
entries.definition:
Counts are **event-row totals** for the member + month (not unique calendar days):
Tableau Yes/No on `VW_Member_Month`: `bh_encounter_flag` (`bh_count > 0`), `rd_encounter_flag` (`rd_count > 0`), `ecmplus_encounter_flag` (`bh_or_rd_count > 0`), plus existing `ecm_billed_touches_flag`.
**Avg. Member Touches** (Tableau) — typically `AVG(ecm_billed_touch_count + bh_or_rd_count)` over members in the month
Workbook formulas (copy-paste Tableau calcs): [`docs/tableau/member_month_kpis.md`](tableau/member_month_kpis.md).
Upstream guards against inflated counts: ECM+ loader drops Sprite claim-line columns (`claim_*`) that fan one encounter into many CSV rows, collapses the extract to one row per `encounter_id`, then skips `encounter_id`s already in STG (monthly files may include other months; composite fallback if id is blank); `CORE_ECMPlus_Encounters` and `CORE_Member_Activity_Log` also dedupe overlapping STG slices; CORE drops out-of-enrollment ECM/ECM+ rows and non-BH/RD ECM+ staff.

entries.name: Who is on the PROD view
entries.topic: Who is on the PROD view
entries.definition:
`VW_Completed_Appointments` keeps every appointment status. Two rules decide which rows are included:
Completed visits are a Tableau filter, not a row drop. `is_completed_appointment` is true when the trimmed status, with collapsed spaces, equals `completed` in any capitalization. `checkedIn`, `provider no-show`, `cancelled`, `member no-show`, and `scheduled` stay on the view so missed-appointment charts can count them. Filter `is_completed_appointment` for the completed-visit charts.
The roster has no active flag and no start or end date. A CHW who leaves and is removed from the roster will no longer validate appointments from the months they worked. Historical appointments are not dropped only because of an inactive flag, because no such flag exists.

entries.name: Phase 1 outreach and enrollment outcomes
entries.definition:
Tableau member-outcome source: `VayuHealth_Program_PROD.VW_Phase1_Member_Outcomes`.
`is_program_discharge` does **not** include graduates. Use `is_program_exit` or `exit_group = Program exit` for the combined program-exit chart, then `is_graduated` or `member_outcome_category = Graduated` for the graduation slice.
`member_outcome_category` is mutually exclusive and uses this order: `Graduated`, `Discharged from Program`, `Discontinued from Outreach`. It is null when none of those outcomes applies.
Outreach after an episode starts is not assigned backward to that episode. Rows without qualifying pre-enrollment outreach have a null `days_from_first_outreach_to_enrollment`.
`VW_Phase1_Member_Outcomes.discontinuation_reason` contains text only. Approved ECM Tracker mappings:
1: The Member has met all care plan goals
2: The Member is ready to transition to a lower level of care
3: The Member no longer wishes to receive ECM
4: The ECM Provider has not been able to connect with the Member after multiple attempts
5: Incarcerated
6: Declined to participate
7: Duplicative program
8: Lost Medi-Cal coverage
9: Switched health plans
10: Moved out of the county
12: Unsafe behavior or environment
14: Deceased
15: Other
Raw code fields remain CORE-only.

Outreach after an episode starts is not assigned backward to that episode. Rows without qualifying pre-enrollment outreach have a null `days_from_first_outreach_to_enrollment`.
`VW_Phase1_Member_Outcomes.discontinuation_reason` contains text only. Approved ECM Tracker mappings:
1: The Member has met all care plan goals
2: The Member is ready to transition to a lower level of care
3: The Member no longer wishes to receive ECM
4: The ECM Provider has not been able to connect with the Member after multiple attempts
5: Incarcerated
6: Declined to participate
7: Duplicative program
8: Lost Medi-Cal coverage
9: Switched health plans
10: Moved out of the county
12: Unsafe behavior or environment
14: Deceased
15: Other
Raw code fields remain CORE-only.

entries.name: Monthly outreach conversion
entries.definition:
Tableau source: `VayuHealth_Program_PROD.VW_Phase1_Monthly_Outreach_Conversion`.
Grain: one row per `member_cin` + `reporting_month` + `outreach_channel`. `reporting_month` is a Log Initial Outreach month, an ECM enrollment-start month, or the Tracker month the member was added to outreach. A member outreached in August and enrolled in September has both months. A member with both channels in one outreach month has two rows. Use `COUNTD(member_cin)`.
`enrolled_in_reporting_month` requires a Log Initial Outreach in the month and an ECM enrollment start in that same month. `enrolled_in_month` is any ECM enrollment start in the month. Outreach can be in an earlier month, including the end of the prior month, or absent. Do not use `COUNTD(member_cin)` as the denominator, because enrollment-only rows are in the view.
`added_to_outreach_in_reporting_month` is the Tracker `member_created_date` month. It includes members who were added and never outreached. Use `reporting_month` as the month axis so region, organization, health plan, care team, and channel filters match the conversion graphs.
On an outreach row, `region`, `organization`, `health_plan`, `care_coordinator_team`, and `outreach_channel` come from that month's outreach. On an enrollment-only row, those attributes come from the enrollment episode, and `outreach_channel` is the latest Log Initial Outreach on or before the enrollment start. On an added-only row, those attributes come from the member's outcome record, and `outreach_channel` is the member's earliest Log Initial Outreach. That channel is blank when the member was never outreached, so an `outreach_channel` filter leaves those members out.
Do not calculate the first-outreach cohort rate on this view. That rate stays on `VW_Phase1_Enrollment_Conversion`.
The monthly unique-outreached card on the events view counts members with **any** Log Initial Outreach in that activity month. Conversion uses **first** outreach month. Those two month counts will not always match.

entries.name: Flourish PAM
entries.definition:
Sprite measurement PAM on `CORE_Member_Measurements` and the cumulative book is a separate record. It is not an input to `VW_PAM_Assessments`. The full procedure is in [`flourish_pam.md`](flourish_pam.md).
`reporting_month` is the UTC date of the Flourish completion timestamp, truncated to the month. A missing or unparseable completion date has no reporting month.
An assessment is initial only when it is sequence 1 in a mapped CIN and survey series. A later sequenced assessment is a follow-up. Tied timestamps are not ordered, and a tied earliest timestamp leaves that series without a baseline.
`PAM13` and `PAM13_S` are separate series. Language variants are separate until `CORE_PAM_Survey_Series_Map` says otherwise. Delivery mode does not start a new series.
Average paired change uses one follow-up per member and series. Monthly charts use the selected follow-up in `VW_PAM_Member_Month`. Overall charts use the latest follow-up in `VW_PAM_Member_Summary`. Do not average the monthly averages, and do not treat an initial row as zero improvement.
`meets_enrollment_tenure_180_days` is optional enrollment tenure at the Flourish completion date. It is not a six-month follow-up, and these fields are not a reproduction of Flourish PAM Trend.
Level member counts on a monthly bar are `COUNT(DISTINCT member_cin)` on the selected monthly row. Summing `is_pam_level_1` counts assessments. A member with two assessments in one month can appear in two levels on the assessment view. `VW_PAM_Member_Month` is the mutually exclusive monthly level.
`No PAM available` is a missing CIN-filter match or a summary row with no sequenced level. It is not PAM level 1.

entries.name: Flourish enrollment / MoM distribution (A1c-style)
entries.definition:
Separate from Trend pairing. Source: Flourish assessments, all survey series pooled per CIN.
Baseline: closest valid completion **before** ECM enrollment start.
Most recent: latest valid completion **on/after day 180** and within the enrollment episode (MoM view also caps at month end).
Distribution charts / run charts: use `distribution_pam_level` / `distribution_pam_score` = most recent if present, else baseline carryforward.
Avg score increase on these views: only where `has_post_180_day_pam` (do not treat carryforward rows as zero change).
Tableau sources: `VW_PAM_Enrollment_Outcomes`, `VW_PAM_MoM_Run_Chart`.

entries.name: Connect only to PROD
entries.definition:
PRAPARE views omit pregnancy/postpartum, EPDS, comments, and infant-care fields (those stay in STG).
Phase 1 outcomes: all program exits (graduates + other discharges) use `exit_group = Program exit` or `is_program_exit`. Discharged members use `is_program_discharge` and do not include graduates. Graduations use `is_graduated`. Source code `1` maps to The Member has met all care plan goals. Calendar-month unique outreached and attempts stay on `VW_Initial_Outreach_Events`. Members added to outreach use `member_created_date` / `added_to_outreach_month` on `VW_Phase1_Member_Outcomes`.
Monthly outreach conversion uses `reporting_month` for every graph on this source. Denominator = `COUNTD` of `member_cin` where `outreached_in_reporting_month`. Same-month numerator = `enrolled_in_reporting_month`. Overall numerator = `enrolled_in_month`, which includes an enrollment after outreach in an earlier month. Members added to outreach = `COUNTD` of `member_cin` where `added_to_outreach_in_reporting_month`. Do not use `COUNTD([member_cin])` as the denominator, and do not sum row counts across channels. An `outreach_channel` filter leaves out members who were added and never outreached, because that channel is blank.
Outreach `region` on the outreach views is already grouped: Humboldt and Sierra (any capitalization) are `Humboldt`; Shasta, Tehama, and Trinity are each one title-case label. Other region text is left as exported. Do not add a Tableau group on top of that.
Do not point Tableau at STG, CORE, or MART.

// Member Enrollment Episode End Date
IF ISNULL([ECM_Enrollment_End_Date]) AND ISNULL([Discontinuation_Date])
THEN NULL
ELSEIF ISNULL([ECM_Enrollment_End_Date])
THEN DATE([Discontinuation_Date])
ELSEIF ISNULL([Discontinuation_Date])
THEN DATE([ECM_Enrollment_End_Date])
ELSEIF DATE([ECM_Enrollment_End_Date]) < DATE([Discontinuation_Date])
THEN DATE([ECM_Enrollment_End_Date])
ELSE DATE([Discontinuation_Date])
END

entries.name: 035. Member Program Length (Months)
entries.definition:
Tableau name: `Member Program Length (Months)`.
Snapshot position 238 of 600 on this page. Workbook association: `Vayu Health Cumulative Members & Outcomes DB`.
**Approval status:** Draft written from the Tableau formula on 2026-11-20, pending review by the data lead.
**Check before approving:** For members with status Exclude it subtracts the end date from itself, so it always returns 0 months; the first date should be the enrollment start date. Compare with "Cumulative Member Program Length (Days)", which does this correctly. Uses today's date, so the value changes every day and does not follow the reporting month on the dashboard.
IF ISNULL([ECM Enrollment Start Date (Calc)])
    OR TRIM(STR([ECM Enrollment Start Date (Calc)])) = ""
THEN
    NULL
ELSEIF LOWER(TRIM(STR([Workflow Status]))) = "enrolled"
THEN
    DATEDIFF(
        'month',
        DATE(LEFT(TRIM(STR([ECM Enrollment Start Date (Calc)])), 10)),
        TODAY()
    )
ELSEIF
    STARTSWITH(LOWER(TRIM(STR([Workflow Status]))), "exclud")
    AND NOT ISNULL([ECM Enrollment End Date (Calc)])
    AND TRIM(STR([ECM Enrollment End Date (Calc)])) != ""
THEN
    DATEDIFF(
        'month',
        DATE(LEFT(TRIM(STR([ECM Enrollment End Date (Calc)])), 10)),
        DATE(LEFT(TRIM(STR([ECM Enrollment End Date (Calc)])), 10))
    )
END

// Member Enrollment Episode End Date
IF ISNULL([ECM_Enrollment_End_Date]) AND ISNULL([Discontinuation_Date])
THEN NULL
ELSEIF ISNULL([ECM_Enrollment_End_Date])
THEN DATE([Discontinuation_Date])
ELSEIF ISNULL([Discontinuation_Date])
THEN DATE([ECM_Enrollment_End_Date])
ELSEIF DATE([ECM_Enrollment_End_Date]) < DATE([Discontinuation_Date])
THEN DATE([ECM_Enrollment_End_Date])
ELSE DATE([Discontinuation_Date])
END

entries.name: A. Original monthly sourcing population
entries.definition:
Python writes `MART_Sourcing_Received` from each source file **before** age or clinical filters:
Stanislaus Cozeva HbA1c → `source_name = stanislaus_cozeva_hba1c`
Stanislaus Cozeva Demographics → `source_name = stanislaus_cozeva_demographics`
Shasta A1C_GT8 → `source_name = shasta_a1c_gt8`
Humboldt PHC DM A1C9+ → `source_name = humboldt_phc_dm_a1c`
Each row keeps county, sourcing month (first of month), source file name, source row number, CIN, DOB, age as of that month, A1c value/date, last admission date, pipeline run id, and ingested_at.
A member who appears again next month is a new received row for that month. Rerunning the same month + county + source **replaces** that slice. It does not append.
**Replacement files:** drop the corrected file in the same Drive folder and rerun that month. The slice replace overwrites the previous received rows for that source. Do not load two versions of the same month side by side.
Count labels:
Do not label the sum of monthly distinct counts as unique members ever received. That number is the `all_months` grain on `VW_Sourcing_Funnel`.

entries.name: C. Actual additions to outreach
entries.definition:
Documented outreach handoff: the latest Sheet row where Verified Eligible? is yes and `date_moved_to_outreach` is populated. On `VW_Sourcing_Members` that is `effective_date_moved_to_outreach`.
`date_moved_to_outreach` on the sync table is the raw Sheet value. Historical rows with Verified Eligible? = no used that column as the date the member was found ineligible. `effective_date_verified_ineligible` uses `date_verified_ineligible` when it is populated, and otherwise uses that old date only for a not-eligible token.
That date is entered on the county Eligibility Verification tab and synced by Apps Script. `sync_timestamp`, `ingested_at`, and current ECM Tracker status are **not** used as the month outreach began.
A member who remains on `PROD_Sourcing` is outreach-ready, not an outreach addition, until `date_moved_to_outreach` is present.

entries.name: E. Attribution
entries.definition:
No prior attribution rule existed in this repo.
**Proposed rule (implemented, pending review):** credit the earliest `sourcing_month` + `county` where `on_final_outreach_ready_list` is true. One outreach event and one first enrollment attach to that cohort only.
Keep every received appearance. Source-grain funnel rows are **cohort fate** for members seen on that source (a member on two Stanislaus files can appear in both source rows). County, month, and all-months totals use attributed events so they do not double-count.
Distinguish:
**Sourcing cohort reporting** (`VW_Sourcing_Funnel` grain source/county/month): what eventually happened to members received in that month.
**Calendar-month activity** (`VW_Sourcing_Activity_Month`): how many attributed outreach additions and enrollments occurred in that calendar month.
`reporting_cutoff_date` is `CURRENT_DATE()`. Recent cohorts have had less time to convert.

entries.name: Grain
entries.definition:
One row per logical batch, not per physical input file.
The Stanislaus load pairs the Cozeva Demographics file and the HbA1c file in one pass and snapshots them with the same `pipeline_run_id`. That run id plus county is the pair. Receipt month is not the pair key, so two batches in one month are not merged, and a blank run id is not treated as a match. If more than one HbA1c filename shares the run id, the batch stays unpaired (`enrichment_pair_ambiguous`).
Shasta and Humboldt were checked. Each loader reads one A1c file and does not attach a second file, so this pairing rule is not applied to them.
`membership_file_name` is the physical file whose distinct CIN count is `total_members_received` for that month. For Stanislaus that is the Cozeva Demographics file, before age and A1c filters. Members on that file with no HbA1c row stay in the count. HbA1c-only CINs are `hba1c_only_member_count` and are not in the denominator. Duplicate HbA1c rows for one CIN are collapsed before the join.
`enrichment_file_name` keeps the paired HbA1c filename. `receipt_month` is the membership file's sourcing month.
Sheet sync has no file id. Verified eligible and program exclusions attach to the Cozeva Demographics CIN on that batch, using that file's receipt month.

entries.name: Grain
entries.definition:
One row per `county` + `sourcing_month` + `member_cin` on the **membership file**:
HbA1c-only CINs are not rows. Duplicate membership-file CINs collapse to one row (`duplicate_cin_on_membership_file` is true when the file had more than one).
Stanislaus `last_test_result` and `last_test_date` come from the paired `stanislaus_cozeva_hba1c` row: same county, sourcing month, `pipeline_run_id`, and CIN, and only when that run has exactly one HbA1c filename. The HbA1c file is collapsed to one row per CIN before the join. A blank run id, or more than one HbA1c filename on the run, leaves the result null. Shasta and Humboldt keep the result stored on the membership file. A1c under 9 is not a flag.

entries.name: Latest Sheet row
entries.definition:
Data Sync keeps one row per county, sourcing month, and member. A later sync updates that row and removes older copies of the same key. This view still keeps the latest `Outreach_Sourcing_List_Updates` row with the same QUALIFY as `PROD_Sourcing`: `ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_cin, County, sourcing_month ORDER BY sync_timestamp DESC)`. Join keys are CIN + county (case-insensitive) + sourcing month as DATE. Sheet edits stay on the original sourcing cohort; they do not move the member to the sync month.
`notes` are not on this view.

entries.definition:
Apps Script stores unconstrained STRING values. Flags use this token list after `LOWER(TRIM(...))`:
Blank `verified_eligible` → `pending_verification_flag = 1` and `verification_status = pending`. Any other non-blank token is `verification_status = unmapped` and `sheet_value_unmapped_flag = 1`. It is not counted as eligible, not eligible, or pending. Review those rows before trusting scorecards.
`dm_type_populated_flag` is 1 when `dm_type` is non-blank. It is not a yes/no field.

entries.name: Flags (1/0, SUM in Looker Studio)
entries.definition:
These disposition flags are independent. One member can have more than one equal to 1. `SUM` in Looker is the count of members who meet that condition. `PROD_Sourcing_File_Dashboard` still counts each member in only the first exclusion reason, so those batch totals can be smaller.
`already_in_outreach_flag` is prior ECM Tracker status. `moved_to_outreach_flag` is the effective Sheet outreach handoff for this sourcing list.
`date_moved_to_outreach` stays on the view as the raw Sheet value. Scorecards that mean a handoff use `moved_to_outreach_flag` or `effective_date_moved_to_outreach`.
`days_sourcing_month_to_outreach` is `DATE_DIFF(effective_date_moved_to_outreach, sourcing_month, DAY)` from the first of the sourcing month, not the file-receipt clock time. NULL when there is no outreach date.
Do not use File Dashboard `final_verified_eligible` as Sheet verified eligible. That File Dashboard field is an outreach-date count.

glossary.meaning: A blood test that shows a person's average blood sugar over about the last three months. Also written HbA1c. Higher numbers mean less controlled diabetes.
A member whose program enrollment covered at least one day of that month.
Google's built-in scripting tool for Sheets, Drive, and Gmail. Our automations in the automation/ folder run there.
The date a rule is measured on. For monthly reporting it is usually the last day of the reporting month.
Business Associate Agreement. The contract that lets a vendor (for example Google) store or process PHI for Vayu Health.
A member's first relevant measurement for an enrollment, picked as the one closest to the enrollment start date. Used to measure change over time.
Blood glucose meter: a finger-stick device a member uses to check blood sugar. Sprite may call it SMBGS.
Behavioral health: mental health services such as therapy or counseling.
Google's cloud database where the pipeline stores its tables.
An ECM activity or encounter whose status is Billed, meaning it was submitted for payment.
The Vayu program team that serves a member: Sequoia, Redwoods, Mariposa, or Sundial. The Outreach Team is not a program care team.
Certified Diabetes Care and Education Specialist.
Continuous glucose monitor: a sensor worn on the body that measures blood sugar all day (for example Dexcom or Libre).
Client Index Number: the Medi-Cal member ID. It is PHI. Never type a real one into GitHub.
Google Colaboratory: the browser notebooks in notebooks/ that run the monthly pipeline.
The BigQuery layer where SQL turns raw source data into business meaning (for example enrollment episodes). CORE objects are views.
The health plan quality platform that Stanislaus County member lists come from.
A table that links one system's member ID to another's. The Flourish crosswalk links Flourish IDs to CINs.
The permanent list of every Vayu enrollment episode, kept in MART_Cumulative_Members.
Diabetes Distress Scale: a short survey about how stressful living with diabetes feels.
The bottom number of a rate: the group being measured.
When a member leaves the program. The reason comes from the MIF.
Enhanced Care Management: the Medi-Cal (CalAIM) benefit that pays Vayu to coordinate care for members with complex needs.
The Sprite report that lists members in outreach and enrollment, with their status and dates.
Vayu's extra clinical services on top of ECM: billed visits with behavioral health (BH) clinicians or dietitian and diabetes educators (RDCDCES).
Electronic health record. Vayu's EHR is Sprite.
One documented visit or service between a staff member and a member.
One stretch of program enrollment, from an enrollment start date to its end. A member can have more than one episode.
The vendor platform where members complete the PAM survey.
A 7-question anxiety screening survey.
Glucose Management Indicator: an estimate of A1c calculated from CGM readings.
A discontinuation because the member met their care plan goals.
What one row in a table stands for, for example one member per month.
Same as A1c.
Health information exchange: a network that shares hospital and clinic records. MedEx is the monthly member list prepared for it.
Google's dashboard tool. The sourcing dashboards are built there.
The BigQuery layer of analysis-ready tables, such as one row per member or per member per month.
Managed care plan: the Medi-Cal health plan a member belongs to (for example Health Net or Partnership HealthPlan).
One row for each member for each month they were in the program. Used to count members and services by month.
A database step that updates rows that already exist and adds rows that are new, without duplicating them.
Member Information File: the ECM file shared with the health plan. It holds discontinuation reasons and population-of-focus flags.
The top number of a rate: the members who meet the condition being measured.
Patient Activation Measure: a 13-question survey (scored 0 to 100, levels 1 to 4) about how ready a person is to manage their own health.
How a member's diabetes is tracked: CGM, BGM, or A1c. Based on their devices and recent readings.
Partnership HealthPlan of California, the health plan for Humboldt and Shasta counties.
Protected health information: anything that identifies a person together with their health or care, such as a CIN, name, date of birth, or diagnosis.
A 9-question depression screening survey.
Population of focus: the ECM eligibility group a member qualifies under.
Population Builder, the Sprite report tool used for the Enrolled Members and Discontinuations exports.
A standard survey about social needs (housing, food, transportation, and more).
The BigQuery layer of approved views. Tableau and Connected Sheets connect only to PROD.
A staff member who is both a Registered Dietitian and a Certified Diabetes Care and Education Specialist.
The calendar month a report covers, written YYYY-MM (for example 2026-10).
Social drivers (or determinants) of health: living conditions such as housing, food, and transportation that affect health.
A monthly list of possibly eligible members that a county or health plan sends to Vayu for outreach.
Sprite Health, Vayu's EHR and care management system. Monthly reports are exported from it.
Staging: the BigQuery layer that holds source files as they arrived, with light cleanup only.
The dashboard tool Vayu uses for program reporting.
A sourcing-list member whom the team confirmed meets the program rules and can be contacted.
A saved database query that always shows current data. Unlike a table, it stores no rows of its own.
Prefix for PROD views that dashboards read, for example VW_Member_Month.
